newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Worldbest sees 96 net doubled.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Worldbest sees 96 net doubled.

text.p: SHANGHAI, Jan 24 (Rueter) - China's textile manufacturer Shanghai Worldbest Co Ltd expects 1996 net profits of more than 80 million yuan, more than double the 37.85 million yuan net profit for 1995, a company official said on Friday.
The official said the figures had yet to be audited.
He attributed the jump to a fall in raw material prices, the company's expanded production capacity and several new products with high profit margins.
The official said the company's net profits in 1997 would continue to rise by at least 20 percent year-on-year.
Shanghai Worldbest posted net profits of 30.66 million yuan for the first half of 1996, up from 15.10 million yuan in the same period of 1995.
The company currently has 198.53 million outstanding shares, consisting of 115 million B shares listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and 83.53 million legal person shares.
